invalidated_predecessor.reuse: none; restart full pass 1 after authorization

critic.delivery: Each critic receives the exact bytes of its preassembled packet file as the collaboration message. Before spawn, hash must match the manifest. After completion, preserve the exact received prompt and raw output; a mismatch invalidates the family.

scorer.delivery: For each opaque label, save raw critic JSON, invoke the assembler, and send the exact scorer-input file bytes unchanged to one new scorer. The scorer must preserve the exact prompt it received. Compare its preserved prompt hash with the assembler-reported scorer_input_sha256 before starting the next scorer.
scorer.stop_rule: Any pre/post scorer-input hash mismatch immediately invalidates the whole family. Do not abbreviate, normalize, selectively retry, or continue to another scorer.
scorer.mapping_seal: Do not reveal mapping until all required pass-1/pass-2 critics and scorers have exact-input hash matches and valid preserved traces.

replication.rule: Unchanged from v2. Pass 1 is an adversarial probe. Any material score, ambiguity, or malformed difference triggers exactly one full-family pass 2. Invalidated predecessor traces do not count as a pass.

authorization: No v3 critic or scorer run before coordinator closes this new Extract gate.
